title: QMIMO: Circuit Based Quantum MIMO Design with Variational Receiver
summary: This paper investigates a quantum extension of classical Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) communication in which the conventional linear channel model is replaced by a parameterized multi-qubit unitary transformation. Within this framework, interference is represented through coherent quantum interactions rather than additive signal coupling. To recover transmitted information, a Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) receiver is introduced that learns an approximate inverse channel transformation through supervised variational optimization.
